formula_contract.rationale: KB now closes damage contributor semantics sufficiently for publish; workshop base scaled by lab/card/module/enhancement/relic/vault multipliers.
Relic health semantics are now explicit in the KB as pct_bonus, matching live-wiki guidance that relic bonuses are additive with similar relics and multiplicative with other bonuses.
Relic health-regen semantics are now explicit in the KB as pct_bonus, matching live-wiki guidance that relic bonuses are additive with similar relics and multiplicative with other bonuses.
KB-routed percent surface; compare remains normalized because EP may emit decimal fractions.
KB and engine now close the destination-specific formula as decimal workshop bonus multiplied by lab and post multipliers.
EP export Max Recovery reflects health-at-max-recovery, not the multiplier surface emitted by the package.

Exact max-rend formula uses the Rend Armor enhancement multiplier on the 8x base cap, with additive lab bonus and module-substat max-rend percent converted onto the base cap; publish separately from base Rend Armor Mult.
Wall Health lab semantics are now explicit in the KB as additive percent points, matching the live-wiki ladder and allowing the destination-specific wall HP formula to publish.
Wall regen depends on tower_regen and uses a wiki-verified wall-regen percent ladder already represented in the KB; with tower_regen contract repaired, publish can be re-enabled.
KB now closes defense-absolute contributor semantics sufficiently for publish; workshop base scaled by lab/card/enhancement/relic/vault multipliers.
Shared base-multiplier family: workshop base multiplier scaled by lab/card/enhancement and post-multiplied by relic/vault bonuses.

Coins / Kill display surface: (((workshop x lab) + generator substat sum) x enhancement spillover x (1+vault)) x all-coin perk multipliers. Coin perks are KB-owned on this surface, not on broad all-coin helper surfaces.

Effective Amplify Bot active range is distinct from the raw medal/lab track row. Formula: (state::bot.amplify.range_m + state::bot.global.range_bonus_m) * 1.33 * (state::tower.range_m / 69.5). Provenance: raw range track in bot-track-registry and towersim-static-ledger; shared flat bonus in compiler-routing-policy and Singularity Harness; amplification factor sanctioned in bot-runtime-contract from verified wiki evidence.
